name: Kami Desu! -Kami wa Onna no Destiny-
original_name: 髪デス！-髪は女の運命(デスティニー)-
source:
The heroine's fate depends on the hairstyle you give her. 

Give her a hairstyle that makes her dream of becoming an idol come true!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6335]NovelGame[/url]]
